## Core Competencies & Multi-Domain Expertise

### 1. Front-End Web Development & Architecture
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React.js, Next.js (App Router, Server Components), TypeScript, JavaScript ES6+, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, SASS/SCSS, Framer Motion.
- **Webmaster & CMS Management**: WordPress (Custom theme tweaking, visual builders, elementor, Gutenberg), CMS integration, domain & hosting configuration, performance tuning.
- **Mobile Development**: React Native cross-platform application design and layout implementation.
- **Digital Publishing**: EPUB/E-book programming for mobile and desktop reading devices.

### 2. UI/UX Design & Product Strategy
- **User Interface (UI) Design**: High-fidelity interface design, typography hierarchy, color theory, micro-interactions, responsive grid systems.
- **User Experience (UX) Research**: User flows, wireframing, usability testing, persona mapping, customer journey optimization.
- **Design Systems**: Building and maintaining design systems, design tokens, component libraries, design documentation in Figma.
- **UX Copywriting**: Structuring clear, user-centric microcopy, CTA optimization, and content hierarchy.

### 3. Web Performance, SEO & AI Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO/LLMO)
- **Core Web Vitals**: Optimization for Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
- **Search Engine Optimization**: On-page technical SEO, structured data (JSON-LD), OpenGraph protocol, semantic HTML5, canonical metadata.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Formatting content to be extracted and cited by AI engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, SearchGPT).
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: Direct Q&A structuring for natural language voice and chat search queries.

## Detailed Professional Career History

1. **Frontend Developer & UI Designer — SproutLoud (2024 - Present)**
   - Designing and developing front-end web experiences optimized for conversion, usability, and performance.
   - Managing CMS platforms (WordPress) and building landing pages and custom web components.

2. **Frontend Developer & UI/UX Designer — Yuxi Global / Client Projects (2022 - 2024)**
   - Combining visual design, interaction logic, and modern front-end best practices for enterprise clients.

3. **UI/UX Designer, Frontend Developer & Graphic Design Leader — TiendApp SAS (2018 - 2022)**
   - Led the UI/UX design and frontend development of TiendApp's ecosystem: Main Web Portal, Super-App Vendedor, E-Commerce B2B platform, PIM (Product Information Management), and BI Reports.
   - Established the company's design system and visual guidelines.

4. **Frontend Developer & Webmaster Lead — El Colombiano (2015 - 2018)**
   - Led portal management (Webmaster) for one of Colombia's largest news outlets.
   - Developed custom web applications and maintained strict brand alignment across digital properties.

5. **Content Coordinator & Frontend Developer — Grupo Éxito / Linkapedia (2013 - 2015)**
   - Managed content calendars and collaborated with design and engineering teams for digital marketing and web portals.

6. **Frontend Developer & EPUB Programmer — Digital Media Agencies (2011 - 2013)**
   - Programmed E-books (EPUB) and mobile web interfaces, ensuring cross-device compatibility.
